info.title: SOLGASES API
info.description: Backend API for catalog, inventory and user/role/permission administration

servers.description: WebLogic 15.1.1 deployment: context root /infrastructure (host and port depend on the environment)
Local executable WAR with the local profile (Spring Boot default port; no server.port is configured)

UserRequest.description: Editable data of a user. The id and the active flag cannot be set by the client; a new user is always active. No password or credential is accepted.

username.description: Unique username. Stored exactly as received (no trimming or normalization).

roleIds.description: Ids of existing roles. Replaces the current roles; an empty list removes them all.

createdAt.description: Technical creation timestamp, assigned by the server

updatedAt.description: Technical last-update timestamp, assigned by the server

permissions.description: Permissions of the role, ordered by id. May be empty.

createdAt.description: Technical creation timestamp, assigned by the server

updatedAt.description: Technical last-update timestamp, assigned by the server. It also changes when the permissions of the role change.

UserResponse.description: An internal user with its roles and their permissions

roles.description: Roles of the user, ordered by id, each with its permissions. May be empty.

createdAt.description: Technical creation timestamp, assigned by the server

updatedAt.description: Technical last-update timestamp, assigned by the server. It also changes when the roles of the user change.

UnitOfMeasureRequest.description: Editable data of a unit of measure. The id and the active flag cannot be set by the client.

code.description: Short code. Stored exactly as received (no trimming or normalization). Must be unique; uniqueness ignores case and accents.

name.description: Unit name. Not required to be unique.

RoleUpdateRequest.description: Editable data of a role. The key cannot be changed.

permissionIds.description: Ids of existing permissions. Replaces the current permissions; an empty list removes them all.

ProductRequest.description: Editable data of a product. The id and the active flag cannot be set by the client. Category and unit of measure are referenced by id.

sku.description: Business identifier. Stored exactly as received (no trimming or normalization). Must be unique; uniqueness ignores case and accents.

description.example: Casco de seguridad tipo I, ajuste con cricket

price.description: Sale price. Must be greater than zero, with at most 2 decimal digits (matches the DECIMAL(12,2) column).

categoryId.description: Id of an existing, active category

unitOfMeasureId.description: Id of an existing, active unit of measure

description.example: Casco de seguridad tipo I, ajuste con cricket

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit in which the product is measured

PermissionUpdateRequest.description: Editable data of a permission. The key cannot be changed.

CategoryRequest.description: Editable data of a category. The id and the active flag cannot be set by the client.

name.description: Category name. Stored exactly as received (no trimming or normalization). Must be unique.

RoleCreateRequest.description: Data to create a role. The key is set only here and can never change afterwards.

key.description: Stable internal key. Unique and immutable once created.

permissionIds.description: Ids of existing permissions. May be empty: a role can exist without permissions.

InventoryMovementRequest.description: Data to register a stock entry or exit. The type is implied by the endpoint.

responsibleUser.description: Identifier of the person responsible for the movement
Identifier of the person responsible for the movement

movementDate.description: Moment the movement took place, assigned by the server

InventoryAdjustmentRequest.description: Data to register a stock adjustment

quantity.description: Quantity to move. Always positive; the effect on stock is determined by direction.

direction.description: Whether the adjustment increases or decreases the stock

responsibleUser.description: Identifier of the person responsible for the adjustment

PermissionCreateRequest.description: Data to create a permission. The key is set only here and can never change afterwards.

key.description: Stable internal key. Unique and immutable once created.

AccessTokenRequest.description: Credentials of an internal user. The password is never logged or returned.

AccessTokenResponse.description: Access token to send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. There is no refresh token.

accessToken.description: Signed JWT (HS256). It identifies the user only; permissions are checked on every request

expiresIn.description: Lifetime of the token in seconds

InventoryResponse.description: The current stock of a product

currentQuantity.description: Current available quantity. Zero if the product has no movement yet.

bearerAuth.description: Access token obtained from POST /api/auth/token; valid for 15 minutes
